decontamination_notes: Real feature from sindresorhus/ky PR #873, merged 2026-07-06, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Adds HTTP QUERY support across five source files (system complexity): source/core/constants.ts adds 'query' to requestMethods (which drives both the ky.query shortcut generation and method uppercasing), source/utils/normalize.ts and source/types/retry.ts add it to the default retryable methods, and source/types/ky.ts and options.ts extend the type surface. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (61d6d66d) to source/ + package.json + license (ky is dependency-free; node-ts image runs the TS source via tsx with Node's global fetch, and loopback node:http servers work in the network-off sandbox). Coverage: 3 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — the ky.query shortcut round-tripping JSON, {method: 'query'} uppercased to QUERY on the wire (observed by the server), and body conveyance; 3 pass_to_pass guards pin ky.get, POST uppercasing, and error-status rejection. Assertions check observed methods/bodies from the tests' own servers, never library error text.

fail_to_pass.name: query_shortcut
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='vb ky.query sends a QUERY request' vb_query.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: uppercased
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='vb query method option is uppercased' vb_query.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: json_body
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='vb ky.query conveys a json body' vb_query.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: post_uppercase
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='vb ky.post uppercases and sends' vb_ky_reg.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: http_error
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='vb error status throws HTTPError' vb_ky_reg.test.ts
